card.name: Words just before "tolerated" in dosing
card.fires_on: The word right before "tolerated" or "tolerability", mostly "well" in "well tolerated", and also "and" or "is" when tolerability comes next. Seen in dose-adjustment instructions.

modes.label: well before tolerated
modes.description: The word "well" (or "very well", "less well") just ahead of "tolerated" in dose-increase conditions.

modes.label: Linking word before tolerability
modes.description: A short linking word such as "and" or "is" where "tolerability" or "tolerated" is expected next.
modes.example: Based on efficacy<< and>> tolerability, dosages may be increased

card.writes: It boosts "tolerated", "tolerance" and "safety" as the next word.
card.plain: It spots the spot where the text is about to say a dose was tolerated, as in "if well tolerated, increase the dose".
